purpose: backend LLM listens for these in stakeholder input
outcome: LLM will tally heard cues into sentiment_delta

positive.cue: keeps message concise and focused on the topic at hand
user message is mostly responsive to what was said, with minimal unrelated tangents

negative.cue: asks a question already answered earlier in the conversation
uses dismissive, insulting, or hostile language toward the stakeholder
gives a vague or non-committal response when specifics were requested
asks more than 2 questions in a single message
